svg.title: Darlene Gig - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 54-55, PDF 55-56. Full single-deck envelope retains broad rounded tapered cabin pod, narrow connecting neck and squared aft heat-shield/drive shoulders with open central stern recess. Illustration and description corroborate distinctive rear flat shielding. Vertical plates simplified to their plan projection; internal seats/cargo and detached weapon key excluded.
